verdict.rationale: Vercel documents per-environment variable management (local, preview, production, custom), team-scoped access tokens, team seat roles (Owner, Member, Viewer), and identity-provider-based access. However, the evidence never shows team-wide shared environment variables or a dedicated secrets-management capability, so the 'central' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: team-level shared env vars managed centrally across projects, a documented secrets/sensitive-variable feature, detailed role-based access control docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Manage local, preview, production, and custom environments and the variables each one uses.
Create and scope Vercel access tokens to your full account, a team, or a single project, then use them to authenticate API and CLI requests.
Seats with Owner or Member roles: $20/month each. These team seats have the ability to configure & deploy projects. Viewer Pro (read-only) seats: Free.
Secure every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider.
